characters.name: Leo
characters.role: Leo, a young boy with big feelings
characters.want: To protect his treehouse and express himself freely

characters.name: Hana
characters.want: To comfort Leo and keep him safe

characters.name: Mayor
characters.want: To tear down the treehouse and enforce order
characters.personality: Impulsive, strict, and quick to anger

title_working: The Day Leo Turned Into A Monster
world_rule: The Day Leo Turned Into A Monster

lines.text: In this town, if you get angry even once, you turn into a monster.
lines.say: (serious) In this town, if you get angry even once, you turn into a monster.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: In a peaceful town, citizens walk cautiously to avoid feeling any anger.

lines.text: So when the Mayor tore down the treehouse, Leo felt his face get hot.
lines.say: (angry) So when the Mayor tore down the treehouse, Leo felt his face get hot.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: The Mayor destroys the treehouse, causing Leo's face to turn bright red with rage.

lines.text: In one flash, Leo grew giant horns and a long purple tail.
lines.say: (angry) In one flash, Leo grew giant horns and a long purple tail.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: In a burst of energy, giant horns sprout from Leo's head and a purple tail grows.

lines.text: Hana cried, but she stayed and sang their treehouse song.
lines.say: (sad) Hana cried, but she stayed and sang their treehouse song.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Tears stream down Hana's face, but she stands firm and softly sings their treehouse song.

lines.text: Then the horns shrank, and the shocked Mayor turned into a monster too.
lines.say: (angry) Then the horns shrank, and the shocked Mayor turned into a monster too.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Leo's horns shrink away, but the enraged Mayor suddenly transforms into a monster himself.

lines.text: So Leo sang for the Mayor, and now nobody has to hide their feelings.
lines.say: (happy) So Leo sang for the Mayor, and now nobody has to hide their feelings.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Leo sings the treehouse song to soothe the Mayor, freeing the town from hiding their true feelings.

Discover how a simple song brings healing and understanding to an entire town.
